enriched_activities.desc: Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Body under blanket. Arms at sides. Breathing slowly. Turns head to left. Moves left arm. Turns body to left side. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Remains still. Turns to right side. Moves right leg. Pulls blanket. Adjusts pillow. Remains asleep.

Wake up. Sit up in bed. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap to body. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil into pan. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off cooker. Pick up plate. Put eggs on plate. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Close refrigerator. Put bread in toaster. Press lever. Wait for toast. Toast pops up. Pick up toast. Put toast on plate. Pick up fork. Sit at table. Eat eggs. Eat toast. Drink milk. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Put plate in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed, packing work bag, and checking the storm forecast on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Take out underwear. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out work bag. Open work bag. Put stethoscope in bag. Put notebook in bag. Put pen in bag. Zip bag. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open weather app. Check storm forecast. Close app. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Stand and wait. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Open door. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to nurse station.

enriched_activities.activity: Working clinical shift caring for patients
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter. Greet patient. Wash hands. Put on gloves. Check vital signs. Use stethoscope. Take blood pressure. Check IV drip. Adjust flow rate. Take temperature. Record data. Walk to nurse station. Pick up medication. Walk to patient room. Administer medication. Check patient comfort. Remove gloves. Wash hands. Walk to next patient.

Walk to cafeteria. Stand in line. Pick up tray. Pick up plate. Serve food. Pay for food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Pick up tray. Return tray. Walk to restroom. Wash hands. Walk back to work area.

enriched_activities.activity: Working clinical shift caring for patients
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter. Greet patient. Wash hands. Put on gloves. Check vital signs. Use stethoscope. Take blood pressure. Check IV drip. Adjust flow rate. Take temperature. Record data. Walk to nurse station. Pick up medication. Walk to patient room. Administer medication. Check patient comfort. Remove gloves. Wash hands. Walk to next patient.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk home. Open front door. Walk to bedroom. Change out of work clothes. Walk to living room.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out pot. Turn on induction cooker. Place pot on cooker. Pour oil into pot. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add sauce. Stir. Turn off cooker. Pick up plate. Put food on plate. Pick up fork. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Put plate in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing for the storm by charging phone, filling water, and locating emergency supplies
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up phone. Plug phone into charger. Connect charger to outlet. Check phone charging. Walk to kitchen. Pick up water bottle. Fill with water from tap. Walk back to living room. Open closet. Take out flashlight. Check batteries. Take out first aid kit. Check supplies. Take out candles. Put supplies on table. Pick up phone. Check charge level. Unplug phone. Put phone in pocket.

Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Flip channels. Settle on a show. Watch. Adjust volume. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Open snack. Eat snack. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

Walk to bathroom. Open door. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap to body. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and winding down for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Pick up book from nightstand. Sit on bed. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe slowly.
